frontmatter.title: Inspect ticket events through readable history and evidence views

document.body:
## What to build

Display a ticket summary above its event history. Opening an event displays a dedicated detail view. Lead with the outcome and readable body before extended evidence metadata.

Keep event identity, execution outcome, review verdict, source identity, and evidence validity distinct. Preserve the current evidence authority and transition restrictions.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Ticket detail displays its identity, available state, and recorded review and fix counts above the event list.
2. Review and fix totals count validated receipts for the respective phases. They describe recorded attempts, not quality or completion.
3. Event rows display distinct identity, outcome, and source fields. A commit reference does not occupy the outcome field for another event type.
4. A completed review with a failure verdict remains distinguishable from a process execution failure.
5. Opening an event displays its outcome and readable body before extended source, workspace, branch, session, and raw-field details.
6. All exact evidence remains reachable through scrolling or an explicit details control. Long source IDs remain readable.
7. Source commit and tree comparisons identify matched, stale, or unavailable evidence. Invalid events remain inspectable with explicit warnings.
8. Dependency information and unresolved blockers remain reachable. Existing workflow transition restrictions remain unchanged.
9. Changed-file counts appear only when durable evidence supplies them. The interface does not infer counts from prose.
10. Event selection survives live history updates. Esc and breadcrumb navigation restore the previous list position.
11. No events, loading history, unreadable history, and refresh failures display distinct explanations.
12. Existing action targets remain explicit. Event inspection does not redirect ticket actions to a historical record.
13. Existing copy and fresh-chat behavior remains unchanged. Colour-independent labels and narrow layouts preserve each field meaning.

## Out of scope

Do not change receipt schemas, evidence validity rules, immutable events, or workflow transition rules.

## Specification

The parent specification defines the complete product intent. This ticket implements only the approved slice.


## Testing decisions

Use the complete modal as the main automated test boundary. Send input through its public interface. Assert visible behavior and canonical targets.

Use the existing modal, explorer, and live-update test patterns. Use temporary stores for record and watcher behavior. Avoid assertions about private arrays or incidental text formatting.

Run the actual Pi modal for terminal acceptance. Inspect 40 by 12, 80 by 24, and 120 by 40 terminals. Inspect colour and monochrome presentation.

Keep existing action, copy, workspace shortcut, and workflow safety behavior intact. Preserve terminal-control sanitization and Unicode display widths.

## Completion evidence

Record the focused behavior checks and terminal observations. Include evidence for the changed screens and relevant failure states.

## Comments

The user approved this slice and its direct blockers during ticket decomposition.

doc.body:
# Context map

Use this file for stable entry points. Do not list individual workflow receipts here.

## Entry points

- [Agent configuration](docs/agents/)
- [Architecture decisions](docs/adr/index.md)
- [Issue tracker configuration](docs/agents/issue-tracker.md)
- [Domain configuration](docs/agents/domain.md)

The issue tracker uses Local Markdown. Read the [tracker index](tracker/index.md) for ticket and initiative navigation. Read `CONTEXT.md` when it exists. Keep architecture decisions under `docs/adr/`. Resolve workflow and source paths through the shared-context CLI when needed.

## Ownership

| Area | Owner | Property |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/agents/` | Repository agent configuration | Authored configuration |
| `docs/adr/` | Domain and architecture skills | Canonical decisions |
| `tracker/` | Matt Pocock ticket skill | Canonical local tickets when configured |
| `workflows/*/events/` | Worktree skill | Authoritative and append-only |
| `workflows/*/artifacts/` | Worktree skill | Immutable outputs |
| `workflows/*/projections/` | Worktree skill | Generated and replaceable |
| `sources/` | Shared-context skill | External and local source copies |
| `domains/` | Domain skill | Stable domain vocabulary and rules |

# Domain docs

This repository uses one context.

## Read before exploration

1. Read `CONTEXT-MAP.md` at the active alignment root.
2. Read `CONTEXT.md` when it exists.
3. Read `docs/adr/index.md` and ADRs that affect the current area.

If a domain document does not exist, continue without it. Use the `domain-modeling` skill to record terms and decisions when they are resolved.

## Document layout

Keep the glossary and domain rules in `CONTEXT.md`. Keep architecture decisions under `docs/adr/`. Keep stable entry points in `CONTEXT-MAP.md`.

Use the glossary's terms in ticket titles, code proposals, hypotheses, and tests. Update domain documents when a resolved decision changes a term or rule.

# Architecture decisions

Use this directory for ADRs that record resolved architecture decisions. Use the shared-context CLI to resolve an ADR path before writing it. Add a link here when an ADR is created.

Read the [domain configuration](../agents/domain.md) for domain document rules.

criteria.text: Ticket summary above event history shows canonical identity, available state and recorded review/fix counts.
Review and fix totals count validated receipts for their respective phases, not invalid raw fields, prose, quality, completion or inferred activity. Keep the approved receipt-based meaning explicit.
Event rows separate event identity, execution outcome and source reference with stable field roles; a commit is never an outcome.
A completed review with verdict FAILURE is visibly distinct from process execution failure. Keep execution and verdict labels separate.
Opening an event produces a dedicated detail view with outcome and readable recorded body before extended evidence metadata.
All exact evidence remains reachable through scrolling or explicit details, including full long commit/tree IDs, workspace, branch, session and raw fields.
Matched, stale and unavailable source evidence are distinct. Invalid events remain inspectable with warnings; preserve existing authority.
Dependencies and unresolved blockers remain reachable. Existing worktree transition restrictions remain unchanged.
Changed-file counts appear only from durable structured evidence; never infer them from prose.
Stable event selection survives live insertions/updates. Esc and keyboard/mouse ancestors restore the previous event-list position.
No events, loading, unreadable history and refresh failure have distinct explanations; retain last readable content after failure without unsafe actions.
Action targets remain the current canonical ticket, never the historical event being inspected.
Preserve copy, fresh-chat, sanitization, Unicode widths, workspace shortcuts, description readers and Files independence. Explicit labels retain meaning at narrow widths and without colour.
